The Mob was gated (STATUS 10/10) with PERSISTENT_LIMITS_ENABLED=true, and its production plan says to set it. NOW.md defers it. Without it, the Mob create, invite, join and report rate limits count per serverless instance. The money and abuse rules that matter are enforced in the database: the free weekly claim (mob_free_claim) and the per-plan Mob cap. My 3104 run used it unset, and the Mob worked. This needs to be a conscious decision when MOB_ENABLED is switched on.
